methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 13 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 20.4x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

data.narrative:
Groq is a private-stage semiconductor chip company founded by Jonathan Ross and Douglas Wightman, having raised $3.54B to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector contains 13 same-sector peers total—3 public (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private including Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, SambaNova Systems, Etched, and Ayar Labs—though the peer set lacks sufficient narrow-stage overlap for traditional multiples work.

Peer-median valuation is not applicable: filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables yielded fewer than three datapoints, making sector-wide median unreliable for this analysis. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales is similarly inapplicable; while public semiconductor comps trade at a 20.4x median P/S across the three tickers, Groq's revenue remains undisclosed, as is typical for private companies at this scale. Neither standard triangulation method produces a defensible estimate.

The analysis reveals that valuation support requires either (1) access to Groq's revenue or forward guidance, enabling P/S application against public comps, or (2) identification of sufficient private comparables at equivalent funding stage and commercialization progress. The $3.54B raised provides a floor proxy for valuation discussions, but the absence of primary financial metrics and tight peer comparability means no quantitative range can be derived from available data. Key uncertainties center on revenue scale, gross margin profile relative to legacy semiconductor incumbents, and whether chip architecture represents marginal or step-function performance differentiation in its target market segment.
